summary: Milestone 2026.09.657 completed 13 experiments, all compute-bound, in 12.3 wall-time minutes. The two longest tasks were 'Measure native Qwen readout through durable feedback acknowledgement' at 3.67 minutes and 'Reduce cross-game live-agent cost and supervisor opportunities' at 3.29 minutes, together accounting for 6.96 minutes. Sub-phase timing was not recorded within these runs to separate inference duration from setup or file serialization overhead.
bottlenecks_identified: 'Measure native Qwen readout through durable feedback acknowledgement' (3.67 minutes) and 'Reduce cross-game live-agent cost and supervisor opportunities' (3.29 minutes) accounted for 6.96 out of 12.3 total wall-time minutes (over 56% of milestone time), but lack granular sub-phase timing to isolate model execution from evaluation scaffolding or file I/O.

The remaining 11 compute-bound tasks completed rapidly in approximately 5.34 minutes combined (led by ARC panel B qualification at 1.41 minutes, V656 contract binding at 0.65 minutes, and static audit at 0.57 minutes), with timestamps reconstructed from disk mtime rather than continuous stage logs.

The GPU monitor report provides an end-of-run snapshot (0% utilization, 4MB allocated across both RTX 3090 GPUs) after milestone completion, leaving GPU utilization and memory bandwidth across active compute execution spans unmeasured.
Task launch records did not log model concurrency or runner dispatch details, although all completed tasks were single-model runs where DualGPURunner multi-model dispatch is not applicable.
improvements_suggested: Instrument granular sub-phase timers and monotonic stage logging inside native Qwen readout and ARC reduction tasks to isolate inference latency from pipeline setup and artifact serialization.
Deploy continuous, task-aligned accelerator telemetry during compute-bound executions to sample live GPU utilization and VRAM allocation across active compute windows.
Record model concurrency and runner dispatch details in task receipts to audit DualGPURunner eligibility whenever two or more models run concurrently.
Implement runtime milestone-scoped execution logging to avoid reliance on disk-mtime post-hoc reconstruction.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument sub-phase duration timers and per-stage progress logging inside the native Qwen readout and ARC cost reduction pipelines.
Deploy continuous accelerator telemetry during compute-bound task execution to record live GPU utilization and VRAM occupancy across active execution windows.
Emit explicit model concurrency and runner dispatch metadata in experiment receipts to audit DualGPURunner engagement on multi-model workloads.
meta_reflection: The milestone completed 13 compute-bound tasks in 12.3 wall-time minutes, with execution concentrated in native Qwen readout (3.67 minutes) and ARC cost reduction (3.29 minutes). The post-run GPU snapshot cannot evaluate active-window compute efficiency, and because only single-model tasks were executed, no DualGPURunner dispatch opportunity was missed. Granular sub-phase timing instrumentation in future milestones is needed to identify concrete optimization targets.
